$comment: Everything about a server's portal membership that is NOT the owning repo's decision: default_disabled, on_behalf and updated_prompts, copied from the live portal (live-snapshot-2026-09-25.json in the #1370 proposal). All six members are vendored; updated_tools appears only on a server with vendored: false, the escape hatch for an owning repo whose file fails the shape rules (api used it until mctlhq/mctl-api#396 gave every entry a reason). Not to be confused with the vendored files' own default_disabled: true (the owning repo's "an unlisted tool is disabled"): the default_disabled here is the portal object's per-server "off by default for connecting clients" switch, false on every member today. mcp-portal.tf reads the portal one from this file only.
